contract: IELTS Telegram Mini App redesign: minimalist and clear learning UI across Today, Lesson, Practice, Exam, Words, Progress, Settings, and Writing; preserve existing API/auth/data/learning behavior. Shared 960px max width, common gutters/spacing, responsive six-tab nav. Existing UI locale is English; Russian appears only in study content.

accessibility.evidence: Local Chromium keyboard Tab reached an activity button with visible 3px focus outline; mobile navigation targets measured >=53x55px; dark primary button text contrast measured 7.17:1. Screen readers and actual Telegram WebView were not tested.

responsive.evidence: Isolated local Chromium with mock data: no horizontal overflow at 320, 375, 390, 768, 1280, 1440; header and content edges aligned; final content clears fixed nav by 45px at 320 and 33px at 390.

loading.evidence: Local mock delayed bootstrap by 900ms; the loading block appeared before the response, then Today loaded. Screenshot: loading-390x844.png.

empty.evidence: Mocked course-not-imported screen clearly states course materials are not loaded and offers View lesson plan; Progress empty state also rendered.

error.evidence: Local mock returned 503 once; the specific error and Try again appeared, and retry recovered with a successful bootstrap. Screenshot: error-retry-390x844.png.

partial.evidence: Mocked weekly-only source showed that daily prompts are not included. Screenshot: partial-course-390x844.png.

success.evidence: Mocked quiz and weekly exam showed results; consented mocked Writing review showed feedback. No real AI/API call was made.

permission.evidence: A local browser with no Telegram initData showed the Open IELTS from Telegram access gate. Screenshot: permission-gate-390x844.png. Real signed initData validation is not tested.
